tests.scenario: Verify the live application against The login page shall include a password show/hide toggle
steps: Check whether the reported discrepancy is present in the live UI
tests.expected_result: The password show/hide toggle is missing from the login page
tests.rc_reasoning: The password show/hide toggle is central to the core business value of secure sign-in, is not entirely dependent on this feature for the user story to function, but does protect user data by allowing them to verify their password entry.

tests.scenario: Verify the live application against The login page shall show a validation message when credentials are invalid
steps: Check whether the reported discrepancy is present in the live UI
tests.expected_result: The login form does not render a validation message after invalid credentials are submitted
tests.rc_reasoning: The acceptance criterion of showing a validation message for invalid credentials is highly central to the core business value of secure sign-in, entirely dependent on this functionality for user story success, and protects user workflow by preventing unauthorized access.

tests.scenario: Verify the live application against The login page shall support the forgot password flow
steps: Check whether the reported discrepancy is present in the live UI
tests.expected_result: The forgot password link is not reachable from the login page
tests.rc_reasoning: The forgot password flow is central to the core business value of secure sign-in, is highly dependent on it for a smooth user experience, and protects user data by providing a secure method for password recovery.
